stages.mythic: Edit this concept. Keep the great dark red and ochre pavilion, the dark oak poles and iron-tipped peaks, the braziers. Remove the figure and all loose banners and curtains; rigid carved oak standards on poles take their place. Go much further: from the centre rises one colossal mast of black oak bound with iron, three times the height of the canvas, carrying three stacked tiers of drum-tight canvas roof narrowing upward, a single immense dark red pennant streaming rigid from its tip against the sky. All the guy ropes shine as thin taut lines of ember light from the ground up to the tiers, and the canvas glows amber from within, strongly by day and night, its seams burning like a lantern. Braziers with tall steady flames, old boots still by the door.
